headline: EFC (I) Limited: Acquisition Update
sum: EFC (I) Limited (EFCIL) intimated the NSE of an acquisition update via Regulation 30 disclosure on 18 August 2026, but the filing does not specify the target, consideration, or transaction structure.
implication: The disclosure trigger under Regulation 30 (substantive corporate action requiring immediate exchange intimation) confirms a material acquisition event; however, absence of party/value detail in the public filing suggests either a conditional or structured announcement phase - partners should seek the full circular or press release for commercial terms and due diligence gating items.
detail: EFC (I) Limited, a public company listed on the NSE, filed a Regulation 30 intimation on 18 August 2026 announcing an acquisition. The NSE filing document URL confirms the submission but the published text does not disclose the target company, acquisition value, transaction structure, or conditions precedent. This suggests either a phased disclosure (initial intimation followed by fuller details under Regulation 30(6) or 31), a confidential transaction under review, or a press release published separately. Partners should cross-check the company's investor relations portal and BSE/NSE announcements page for the accompanying press release or board resolution.

framework.ref: Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, Regulation 30
framework.note: central - mandatory intimation to exchange of material corporate action (acquisition) within 30 minutes of board decision or approval
central - board approval threshold and disclosure for acquisition of company assets or business undertaking
central - shareholder approval (if acquisition value exceeds 25% of net worth or if target is a related party)
central - CCI merger/acquisition notification and approval required if deal crosses prescribed asset/turnover thresholds
conditional - if acquisition involves foreign investor / outbound investment, FEMA compliance and RBI approval may apply
conditional - if target is undergoing IBC proceedings, acquisition may proceed via resolution plan or other mechanism

framework.ref: Income Tax Act, 1961, Section 48 & Schedule VI (Amalgamation & Merger provisions)
framework.note: conditional - taxation treatment, capital gains, and withholding obligations dependent on deal structure (merger/asset purchase/share purchase)

conditions: Regulation 30 disclosure to NSE/BSE required within 30 minutes of board approval
CCI approval likely required (threshold: asset value or turnover-based)
Shareholder approval likely required if acquisition value exceeds 25% of net worth (Section 230, CA 2013)
approvals: Board of Directors of EFC (I) Limited

triggers.note: Triggered mandatory exchange intimation; phased disclosure suggests conditional or structured transaction
Acquisition likely triggers CCI notification requirement depending on financial thresholds of target
Shareholder approval gating item if acquisition value material (>25% net worth)
